# Review Report — PR #2069 (Remove the stall-observer workflow, its scan helper, and its two config keys)

## Verdict: APPROVE

## Diff classification
`engine_self_modifying` (touches `lib/**`) → full Phase 1+2 checklist (no skip). `small_diff`=false (18 files, ~580 changed lines), `config_only`=false (diff includes `.sh` and `.py`), `has_new_types`=false, `detect_all_audit`=false (the change edits the *expected literals* of pre-existing completeness audits in `lib/test/run.sh` rather than introducing or restructuring an enumerate-and-assert-complete audit). Phase 3 roster gated on this profile: four always-on agents + `pr-test-analyzer` (diff modifies test files `test_python_scripts.py` / `_part4.py`); `type-design-analyzer` skipped (`has_new_types` false).

## Change under review
A pure deletion removing the report-only stall-observer mechanism: deletes `.github/workflows/stall-observer.yml` and `scripts/stall-observer-scan.py`; removes the `prflow_implement.stall_observer` block (`enabled`, `advisory_threshold_minutes`) from `.prflow/config.json`, `.prflow/config.example.json`, and `.prflow/config.schema.json`; drops the `stall-observer` basename from three coupled expected-literals in `lib/test/run.sh` (`_582_INTERNAL` partition + two `--print-never-shipped-set` expectations); removes the coverage-map entry and adds the required `coverage-map-retention-allow.json` declaration; removes the `brand-devflow-buckets.json` row; deletes the `#1027` test block in `test_python_scripts_part4.py` and the dead-residue block in `test_python_scripts.py`; removes six documentation passages; and adds a `.changeset/` entry. No new runtime logic.

## Acceptance-criteria compliance (issue #2065)
- AC1 — SATISFIED: neither `stall-observer.yml` nor `stall-observer-scan.py` is tracked.
- AC2 — SATISFIED: an independent tree search for `stall-observer`/`stall_observer` returns exactly the four allowed locations (`CHANGELOG.md`, `.prflow/logs/pin-corpus-inventory.tsv`, `lib/test/coverage-map-retention-allow.json`, `.changeset/issue-2065-remove-stall-observer.md`) and nothing else. The `pin-corpus-inventory.tsv` / `CHANGELOG.md` matches are frozen historical records, correctly left untouched per CLAUDE.md.
- AC3 — SATISFIED: `coverage-map-retention-allow.json` carries `{half:"files", key:"scripts/stall-observer-scan.py", reason:<non-empty>}`.
- AC4 — post-PR merge gate: the required checks `lib + python tests` and `lint (shellcheck + actionlint + ruff)` gate the merge and cannot be executed from this local review tier; test/registry coupled sites were reconciled in-change, so no in-suite breakage is expected.
- AC5 — SATISFIED: deletions only; no new workflow, scheduled job, or workpad-staleness scanner introduced.
- AC6 — SATISFIED: `.changeset/issue-2065-remove-stall-observer.md` present (`type: Removed`, `bump: patch`), rationale accurate.

## Phase 3 findings
None. All five dispatched agents returned and reported zero findings.
- code-reviewer: no issues ≥ confidence 80; verified all three coupled `run.sh` literals dropped `stall-observer`, the #582 partition stays exhaustive-and-disjoint, all six edited JSON files parse, and no diff-added prose is false against HEAD.
- silent-failure-hunter: no coupled guard left failing open; schema `additionalProperties:false` forces the three config files to be removed together (fail-closed), retention-allow entry is the legitimate fail-closed escape hatch (not a bypass), and no error-handling gap is left (the deleted helper had no other caller).
- comment-analyzer: added prose (changeset note, retention `reason`) accurate; prevention-only comment standard not implicated. Grade APPROVE.
- pr-test-analyzer: symmetric deletion; the two removed test blocks covered only the deleted helper/workflow (one was dead residue with zero assertions); existing detectors genuinely cover each regression mode; no new test owed (consistent with #2065's no-new-test mandate).
- requesting-code-review (final pass): all checkable ACs verified against the tree; coupled sites consistent; APPROVE.

## Assessment
Clean, well-scoped, fully-coupled removal. Every coupled site (config, schema, tests, coverage map, brand buckets, install-set assertions, docs, changeset) was reconciled in the same change; no replacement mechanism was introduced; and the deletion introduces no silent failure or vacuous guard. Merge readiness rests on the required CI checks passing, which is the normal post-PR gate.
